prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 88.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive Pet Personality Traits Selector Screen: Inserts a new 'new_pet_traits' screen right after pick_friend where users select pet temperament, playfulness, and vocalness before generating. (why: Adoption has a low 68.0% conversion and takes 89s median; letting users customize personality boosts emotional investment and reduces custom pet dissatisfaction.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls & Summon Practice Sandbox Screen: Adds an interactive practice sandbox screen ('new_controls_sandbox') right before home_intro to let users try hiding, calling, and chatting with their pet. (why: Finish step drops to 64.8% and support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Guided Desktop Companion Calibration Flow: Introduces a step-by-step desktop positioning flow ('new_desktop_calibration') into finish to verify multi-monitor pet positioning and taskbar docking. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not displaying on desktop or app not opening, plus 4 emails about desktop feature misbehavior.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Dock Minimization System Tray Notice: Enables OS notification and taskbar pin instructions while background downloads complete. (why: Home waiting takes 201s median / 2336s mean, leading users to accidentally close or abandon the installer.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Split Preview Story Screen Layout: Changes the initial story screen layout to split view featuring animated pet teasers alongside welcome text. (why: The choose_path step sees 23.8% dropoff in the first 8 seconds; rich visuals increase immediate engagement.)
5: [home, wait_info] Live Asset Download Progress Counter: Displays detailed progress data (MB downloaded, remaining render steps) on the waiting screen. (why: High mean waiting time (2336s) causes users to think the app froze when pet model rendering is active.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Quick Commands Summary Header: Adds clear actionable headline copy and keyboard shortcut callouts to the home intro screen. (why: Users finishing setup are confused about how to hide or interact with pets once onboarding completes.)

scores.note: Adoption has 32% dropoff, but adding a mandatory new screen risks increasing friction.
Finish step loses 35.2% and support emails confirm control confusion, though new screen implementation cost is high.
Targeted step has highest dropoff (35.2%) and 7 support emails point directly to display/calibration bugs.
Long mean wait times on home step suggest background abandonment, though support emails don't explicitly mention it.
Choose_path has a 23.8% dropoff within 8s; visual layout tweaks are easy to ship.
Extremely high mean wait time (2336s) on home step makes detailed progress feedback effective for retention.
High cost efficiency (copy update only) targeting the finish step dropoff and confusion.
